value.rationale: Spatial checkerboards are the minimal natural two-cluster invariant configuration in the exact published nearest-neighbor model. The rational parameters are a literal extremal corner of its published Case-B numerical study, making the finite-slice calculation motivated rather than arbitrary. The theorem entirely classifies nonzero antisymmetric fixed states, separates the sink and unstable branches, proves strict mode-by-mode stability for all even lattice sizes, and adds two nonhomogeneous open basins to the two known homogeneous ones. This is a qualitative and robust multistability distinction, not a renaming or a marginal numerical improvement.
